drive.title: Drive the hallway
drive.note: Drove 3.7 m from the bedroom to the end of the hallway, 26 W.

pick_can.title: Pick up an empty can
pick_can.note: The can ended up in the tote.

full_can.title: Don't spill the drink
full_can.note: Weighed 190 g (an empty can is 15 g), so it kept the can upright and carried it off without spilling.

pick_sneaker.title: Pick up a sneaker
pick_sneaker.note: The sneaker ended up in the tote.

pick_sock.title: Pick up a sock
pick_sock.note: The sock ended up in the tote.

pick_paper_bag.title: Carry a paper bag
pick_paper_bag.note: Pinched the rim, lifted the bag and carried it 1 m without dropping it.

door.title: Open the laundry closet
door.note: Door opened 12 degrees (the robot's own body blocks more in this layout).

dryer.title: Reach into the dryer
dryer.note: Gripper inside the dryer drum at 1.52 m.

dock.title: Charge itself
dock.note: Charging at 1.9 A after backing in from 1.2 m.

shove.title: Take a bump
shove.note: Rode out the 80 N bump; the 200 N shove did not tip it. A tipped robot stops its motors and calls for help.
